description: Start a Feature's approved mission, show its plan and clock, list the stories and Bugs that can start now, in order, gate each milestone, stop, resume, end, or extend it, or run the hourly tick.

action.description: start: a person starts the approved mission, through GitHub's device flow, and the plan records them, their tool for this repository, and the budget, then Start begins the mission's Kanha on that tool; given a Tatkal Feature's story, it starts that story on the person's own tool; refused for an agent lane. show: print the plan, each number with its source. next: list the mission's stories and Bugs that can start now, in order (priority, slice order, Ready time), and why each other one waits, with no model call; it claims each start on the ledger (missions/<f>/claims.jsonl), so two runs never start one story, and only the mission's recorded tool runs it. It also lists every event since events_cursor in missions/<f>/plan.json (each story's close and each line of its delegation history), and moves the cursor once the list and its claims are written. With --json it is an aayudha.work/v1 list: {schema, scope {kind, id}, items [{key, action, reason, subthread}], events [{at, story, event}]}; once a mission's clock reaches [mission] max_hours its stories wait. stop: a person stops the mission (or one story or Bug with --story), through GitHub's device flow and from any tool: mission next starts nothing and ship merges none of its PRs; each running Amp, Claude Code, or Cursor thread is told to commit at its next checkpoint and stop, and a thread aayu cannot reach is named; claims, branches, and PRs stay, and other missions and loops run on. resume: a person on the mission's recorded tool continues it (or one story with --story) and starts stories up to its agents. Each control is recorded in the plan's controls; both are refused for an agent lane. gate: run the gate of each milestone whose last story merged on the dev tip (the required checks, aayu verify --check all, and the evals of the seats the milestone touched; no model decides), mark it passed or failed with the dev SHA in missions/<f>/plan.json, and list one fix per failed check, claimed in one agents slot; a check that failed for its runner reruns once; after [mission] max_no_go failed runs the mission stops and asks a person in aayu inbox. budget: a person raises the budget with a reason, or keeps a fix PR waiting. extend: a person, through GitHub's device flow, gives a mission that reached its time limit another [mission] max_hours, with --reason; refused for an agent lane. tick: the build-ready loop's hourly safety tick, with no model and no Feature. It wakes each started mission's cloud Kanha that has a free agent and a story that can start and was told nothing in the last hour, at most once a tick, and records the wake in missions/<f>/plan.json. Then it syncs each open cloud pull request of Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code once with aayu build <n> --delegate <receiver>, and lists those at merge-ready for aayu ship. It never builds, claims, or starts a story.

end.description: With stop: end the mission, only by the person who started it. Merged stories stay merged; each open story and Bug loses its claims and goes back to status:ready, its open PRs close, the lock ends, and each locked issue gets one comment.

feature.description: Feature whose mission to start, show, list, gate, budget, stop, resume, or extend; with start, also a Tatkal Feature's story to start; tick takes none.

keep.description: With budget: keep this fix PR waiting, and close its inbox card.

once-more.description: With gate: run the stopped gate once more, after the presence check; refused for an agent lane.

pr.description: With gate: record this fix PR in the plan's gate_fixes, with the failed check its body names on a line `Aayudha-Gate-Fix: <milestone> <check>`; it files no issue. A fix that would pass the budget waits (exit 6), and an inbox card asks a person.

reason.description: With stop: why, in one line; it is recorded and shown wherever the stop is. With budget --to: why the budget rises. With start: why the mission starts although its learned working hours pass [mission] max_hours (needed then). With extend: why it may run another [mission] max_hours (needed).

story.description: With stop or resume: only this story or Bug of the mission; the rest runs on.

to.description: With budget: the new budget in USD, after the presence check.
